findings.title: No node matches the pod's node selector
findings.cause: no node has the labels sandbox.example.com/runtime=gvisor that the pod's nodeSelector requires; sandbox.example.com/runtime=gvisor comes from RuntimeClass kd-faults-sandboxed (handler runc), whose scheduling.nodeSelector is merged into every pod that uses it, not from the pod's own template; Deployment scanner has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

evidence.command: kubectl get pod scanner-6bd9474d68-kc42c -n kd-runtimeclass-node-selector -o jsonpath='{.spec.nodeSelector}'

evidence.what: none of the 1 nodes has sandbox.example.com/runtime=gvisor

findings.fix: Label the nodes that have the runc runtime handler with sandbox.example.com/runtime=gvisor (the runtime's installer usually does), or, if none has it, install it on a node pool or stop using RuntimeClass kd-faults-sandboxed; the pod template's own nodeSelector is not where this comes from.
